title.zh: 简柚薇 · 以太染色与补羽循环
title.en: Jane / Yuzuha / Vivian · Ether coloring and feather cycle

summary.zh: 柚刷新后让薇先染以太；浮游转羽再交简，以真实EX与异常驱动后台落羽。
summary.en: After Yuzuha refreshes, let Vivian color Ether, convert Flight while floating, then return to Jane; actual EX/Anomaly triggers drive off-field Featherbloom.

conditions.zh: 循环站位柚叶→薇薇安→简，可整体旋转；这是0影无专武可用的以太路线。
conditions.en: Use cyclic order Yuzuha→Vivian→Jane; rotations are equivalent. This is the Ether route usable at M0 without signatures.

conditions.zh: 先看实有能量、飞羽／护羽、惊吓与染色；资源不足就恢复，不把开局当作全员满能量。
conditions.en: Check actual energy, Flight/Guard, Sweet Scare and color. Recover missing resources rather than assuming everyone starts full.

conditions.zh: 作者2.1组合建议加各角色旧版操作教学，交叉固定Gachabase 3.3；没有固定秒轴、帧数或最高分保证。
conditions.en: Combines the authored 2.1 team route with older individual tutorials, checked against fixed Gachabase 3.3; no fixed seconds, frame data or maximum-score promise.

conditions.zh: 不使用潜能觉醒或旧版共享喧响规则；所有强制连携和快支只按实际提示。
conditions.en: No Potential awakening or obsolete shared-Decibel rules; use forced Chains and Quick Assists only on actual prompts.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 柚叶染色与简薇柚／柳薇柚（2.1）
label.en: Orange · Yuzuha coloring and Jane/Yanagi teams (2.1)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 薇薇安补羽与后台输出（1.7）
label.en: Orange · Vivian feather cycle and off-field damage (1.7)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 简的狂热与萨霍夫跳（1.1）
label.en: Orange · Jane Passion and Salchow Jump (1.1)

label.zh: 柚叶 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Yuzuha · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 薇薇安 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Vivian · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 简 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Jane · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 先染以太、准备护羽，再让主攻建异常。
objective.en: Establish Ether color and Guard before the main attacker builds Anomaly.

title.zh: 柚叶EX挂惊吓，再接薇薇安
title.en: Yuzuha applies Sweet Scare, then offers Vivian entry

input.zh: 能量足够时点按EX；命中后按薇薇安实际亮起的支援或连携提示。
input.en: With enough energy, tap EX; after the hit, take the actual Vivian assist or Chain prompt.

trigger.zh: 需要刷新狸之愿／甜蜜惊吓／甜度点；目标可命中。
trigger.en: Tanuki Wish, Sweet Scare or Sugar Points need refreshing, and the target can be hit.

complete.zh: 发动获得2甜度点；重击命中才确认惊吓，攻击命中才确认增益与提示。
complete.en: Activation gives two Sugar Points. Confirm Sweet Scare on the heavy hit, and the buff/prompt on the actual hit.

reason.zh: 每次重挂惊吓都会移除原染色；下一步要让薇的以太攻击先染，不能切主攻抢先命中。
reason.en: Refreshing Sweet Scare removes the old color. Vivian must provide the next qualifying Ether hit before the main attacker changes the color.

fallback.zh: 缺能量先由主攻正常积蓄回能；普通特殊技不代替本招。已有以太染色与增益、只需补羽时可普通切薇，跳过提示入场。
fallback.en: If short of energy, build resources with the main attacker; normal Special does not replace this EX. If Ether color and buffs already hold and only feathers need refilling, switch normally to Vivian and skip prompt entry.

signal.zh: 有薇快支／连携提示才择一接手；未刷新且已有正确染色时按恢复分支普通切薇。
signal.en: Take exactly one actual Vivian Quick Assist/Chain prompt; use the normal-switch recovery only when existing color/setup already suffice.

title.zh: 按提示接薇薇安：两种入场择一
title.en: Enter Vivian once: choose the actual prompt

input.zh: 快支提示：按薇快支，需补羽且已有飞羽时在动作中按住普攻进浮游。连携提示：选择薇连携；本事件只做其中一种。
input.en: Quick Assist: take Vivian’s prompt; when feathers need converting and Flight exists, hold Basic during the move to float. Chain: select Vivian’s Chain instead. Execute only one entry.

trigger.zh: 提示确实指向薇；柚2的合法强制连携或普通失衡连携都以实际提示为准。
trigger.en: The prompt actually targets Vivian. A valid Yuzuha M2 forced Chain or an ordinary Stun Chain must visibly occur.

complete.zh: 薇的以太部分命中完成以太染色；快支默认进淑女，持有飞羽并按住普攻才转浮游；连携回复2飞羽并入浮游。
complete.en: Vivian’s Ether hit establishes Ether color. Quick Assist normally enters Noblewoman; Flight plus held Basic enters Fluttering. Chain gives two Flight and enters Fluttering.

reason.zh: 物理部分不是薇本属性的染色命中；不能把同一次提示算成快支加连携两次入场。
reason.en: The Physical portion is not Vivian’s matching-attribute hit. Do not count one prompt as both Quick Assist and Chain entries.

fallback.zh: 没有提示就跳过，不能空按快支。若已普通切入，使用实际可用招式打以太，再按下一步恢复飞羽。
fallback.en: Skip without a prompt; do not invent an assist. After normal entry, land available Ether damage and restore Flight in the next step.

actionLabel.zh: 快速支援／连携（按实际提示择一）
actionLabel.en: Quick Assist / Chain Attack (choose the actual prompt)

title.zh: 飞羽不够再补，已有资源就省略
title.en: Refill Flight only when the current supply is insufficient

input.zh: 缺飞羽且能量够时点按薇EX；不要按住闪避取消浮游。
input.en: When Flight is insufficient and energy is available, tap Vivian EX; do not hold Dodge to cancel floating.

trigger.zh: 现有护羽和可转化飞羽不足以支撑这轮；若已经足够，不必重复补。
trigger.en: Current Guard and convertible Flight do not cover the intended sequence. Skip unnecessary refills when they already suffice.

complete.zh: 发动基础获得3飞羽并进入浮游；6影额外回复1飞羽，上限仍为5，以实际库存为准。
complete.en: Activation grants three Flight and enters Fluttering; M6 grants one additional Flight. The cap remains five; use the actual stock.

reason.zh: 资源准备是为主攻的EX和异常触发提供护羽；不是每次切薇都强制放EX。
reason.en: Prepare Guard for the main attacker’s EX and Anomaly triggers; Vivian does not need EX on every entry.

fallback.zh: 没能量：已在淑女时点普攻舞步，命中回1飞羽并入浮游；普通切入且未进淑女则先打到普攻第四段。护羽足够时跳过补羽，仍在下一步普通切主攻。
fallback.en: Without energy, use Waltz from Noblewoman: a hit gives one Flight and permits floating. After normal entry outside Noblewoman, first finish Basic 4. If Guard already suffices, skip refilling but still switch normally to the main attacker in the next event.

title.zh: 确认浮游后悬落，普通切回简
title.en: Confirm Fluttering, then switch normally to Jane

input.zh: 确在裙裾浮游且需转羽时普通切主攻，薇自动悬落；也可先点普攻悬落，动作完成后再切。
input.en: While actually in Fluttering and needing conversion, switch normally to the main attacker to auto-Suspension; alternatively press Basic, finish Suspension, then switch.

trigger.zh: 已经进入浮游，不只是持有飞羽。染色应已是以太；护羽不缺可省略本招但仍完成普通换人。
trigger.en: Fluttering must actually be active; merely owning Flight is insufficient. Ether color should be established. Skip the move if Guard is sufficient, but still switch normally.

complete.zh: 悬落消耗现有飞羽，按实际结果核对护羽（最多5）；薇6还会消耗护羽，不能沿用动作前库存。
complete.en: Suspension spends current Flight; read the resulting Guard, capped at five. Vivian M6 also spends Guard, so do not carry over the pre-move count.

reason.zh: 这是固定技能明确允许的自动悬落交棒；后台落羽仍要真实护羽和触发，不能当无限自动输出。
reason.en: The fixed skill explicitly permits this auto-Suspension handoff. Later off-field Featherbloom still needs real Guard and triggers.

fallback.zh: 未浮游先回补羽步骤；如果以太染色和护羽已经够用，跳过悬落并普通切主攻，不要卡在原角色。
fallback.en: If not floating, return to feather setup. If Ether color and Guard already suffice, skip Suspension and switch normally; do not remain on the wrong character.

signal.zh: 确认浮游才可切出自动悬落；省略补羽时也要普通切回主攻。
signal.en: Only actual Fluttering allows auto-Suspension; skipping a refill still requires a normal switch back to the main attacker.

title.zh: 简站场建立强击，观察护羽触发
title.en: Jane builds Assault and watches the feather triggers

input.zh: 以普攻积蓄；敌人真实攻击到来时再做极限闪避和合法反击。
input.en: Build with Basics; use Perfect Dodge and a valid counter against actual enemy attacks.

trigger.zh: 柚的以太染色已建立，薇护羽按实际核对；简还需物理积蓄或狂热。
trigger.en: Yuzuha is Ether-colored and Vivian’s Guard is checked; Jane still needs Physical buildup or Passion.

complete.zh: 狂热、强击与紊乱分别看真实状态；简施加异常有护羽时可触发薇落羽，不保证固定几次普攻就爆条。
complete.en: Read Passion, Assault and Disorder from actual results. Jane applying an Anomaly can trigger Featherbloom with Guard; no fixed Basic count guarantees a proc.

reason.zh: 作者的以太支援路线让简处理强击与异色紊乱；薇异放还要求落羽命中时目标处于异常。
reason.en: The authored Ether-support route lets Jane drive Assault and cross-attribute Disorder. Abloom additionally requires Featherbloom to hit an Anomalous target.

fallback.zh: 染色错误回柚重新挂惊吓再给薇染；护羽耗尽回补羽，不假称落羽一直触发。
fallback.en: If coloring is wrong, reapply Sweet Scare and let Vivian color it. Refill exhausted Guard instead of assuming constant Featherbloom.

label.zh: 以太彩糖花火 · 仅限已染以太且甜蜜惊吓仍在的目标
label.en: Ether Sugarburst · only on the Ether-colored target while Sweet Scare remains

label.zh: 落羽生花 · 有护羽且实际命中EX／队友施加异常时触发
label.en: Featherbloom · requires Guard Feathers and an actual EX hit / ally-applied Anomaly

title.en: Land Jane EX to trigger Vivian’s Featherbloom

input.zh: 能量足够时点按EX，完成踢击和横扫。
input.en: With enough energy, tap EX and complete the kicks and sweep.

trigger.zh: 确有EX能量且目标可命中；想触发落羽须有护羽，想触发异放还须有异常目标。
trigger.en: EX energy and a hittable target are required. Featherbloom needs Guard; Abloom also needs the target to be Anomalous.

complete.zh: 确认EX实际命中；薇同一EX最多响应一次，不按多段踢击重复计算消耗。
complete.en: Confirm the EX actually hits. Vivian responds at most once to the same EX, not once per kick.

reason.zh: 以太染色与薇的后台攻击补另一属性，简仍负责实际物理积蓄；有标记不等于已触发异常。
reason.en: Ether coloring and Vivian supply the other attribute while Jane builds Physical. A mark is not itself a completed Anomaly.

fallback.zh: 缺能量继续普攻与实际闪反；护羽为0时EX仍可正常出伤，但不要计入薇的额外触发。
fallback.en: Without energy, continue Basics and valid counters. At zero Guard, EX can still deal its own damage, but do not count a Vivian trigger.

label.zh: 以太彩糖花火 · 仅限已染以太且甜蜜惊吓仍在的目标
label.en: Ether Sugarburst · only on the Ether-colored target while Sweet Scare remains

label.zh: 落羽生花 · 有护羽且实际命中EX／队友施加异常时触发
label.en: Featherbloom · requires Guard Feathers and an actual EX hit / ally-applied Anomaly

prep.zh: 开局EX缺能量可先用主攻积蓄与回能，准备齐再执行；柚1也不保证EX天然可用。
prep.en: If opening EX lacks energy, start with the main attacker’s buildup/recovery. Even Yuzuha M1 does not guarantee an immediately affordable EX.

label.zh: 常态循环
label.en: Regular loop

objective.zh: 辅助需补才离场；重挂惊吓后重新以太染色。
objective.en: Leave the main attacker only when setup needs refreshing; recolor Ether after reapplying Sweet Scare.

title.zh: 狂热有余量时用萨霍夫跳续航
title.en: Use Salchow Jump with room to restore Passion

input.zh: 有使用次数时长按普攻；按安全时机松开打终结一击。
input.en: With a use available, hold Basic; release safely for the finishing hit.

trigger.zh: 狂热有效且有可用次数，心流已有回复空间；本轮不为回满而无故溢出。
trigger.en: Passion is active, a use remains, and the gauge has room for recovery; avoid wasting the refill.

complete.zh: 实际命中回复心流；完成终结一击后再处理补辅助或继续输出。
complete.en: Actual hits restore Passion Stream. Finish the final hit before refreshing supports or continuing damage.

reason.zh: 这队先给稳定续航，不沿用简赛露的招架方向，也不声称任意时刻普通切人都能保住终结一击。
reason.en: This route favors reliable upkeep; it does not inherit Jane/Seth/Lucy’s parry direction or assume every ordinary early switch preserves the finisher.

fallback.zh: 无次数或未狂热就用普攻及实际闪避恢复；需补辅助时完成可用攻击后仍普通切柚。
fallback.en: Without a use or Passion, recover through Basics and actual dodges. If support needs refreshing, finish the available attack and still switch normally to Yuzuha.

label.zh: 以太彩糖花火 · 仅限已染以太且甜蜜惊吓仍在的目标
label.en: Ether Sugarburst · only on the Ether-colored target while Sweet Scare remains

label.zh: 落羽生花 · 有护羽且实际命中EX／队友施加异常时触发
label.en: Featherbloom · requires Guard Feathers and an actual EX hit / ally-applied Anomaly

signal.zh: 终结一击完成后，确需刷新时普通切柚；增益和护羽都够则留简继续输出。
signal.en: After the finishing hit, switch normally to Yuzuha only if setup needs refreshing; otherwise keep Jane on field.

input.en: With enough energy, tap EX and complete the kicks and sweep.

trigger.en: EX energy and a hittable target are required. Featherbloom needs Guard; Abloom also needs the target to be Anomalous.

complete.zh: 确认EX实际命中；薇同一EX最多响应一次，不按多段踢击重复计算消耗。
complete.en: Confirm the EX actually hits. Vivian responds at most once to the same EX, not once per kick.

reason.zh: 以太染色与薇的后台攻击补另一属性，简仍负责实际物理积蓄；有标记不等于已触发异常。
reason.en: Ether coloring and Vivian supply the other attribute while Jane builds Physical. A mark is not itself a completed Anomaly.

fallback.zh: 缺能量继续普攻与实际闪反；护羽为0时EX仍可正常出伤，但不要计入薇的额外触发。
fallback.en: Without energy, continue Basics and valid counters. At zero Guard, EX can still deal its own damage, but do not count a Vivian trigger.

label.zh: 以太彩糖花火 · 仅限已染以太且甜蜜惊吓仍在的目标
label.en: Ether Sugarburst · only on the Ether-colored target while Sweet Scare remains

label.zh: 落羽生花 · 有护羽且实际命中EX／队友施加异常时触发
label.en: Featherbloom · requires Guard Feathers and an actual EX hit / ally-applied Anomaly

prep.zh: 染色、增益与护羽足够时省略中间整段补充，让主攻继续；若已切到薇，省略动作也要普通切回主攻。
prep.en: If color, buffs and Guard suffice, skip the whole refresh segment and keep the main attacker active. If already on Vivian, skipping actions still requires switching back.

prep.zh: 护羽为0时不要把后台触发计入；需要重染时让薇的以太命中先于主攻。
prep.en: At zero Guard, do not count off-field triggers. When recoloring, Vivian’s Ether hit must precede the main attacker.

label.zh: 爆发窗口
label.en: Burst window

objective.zh: 窗口前补准备；各自Q只按就绪与实际异常兑现。
objective.en: Prepare before the window; spend independently ready Ultimates against the actual Anomaly state.

title.zh: 窗口前用就绪的柚Q刷新准备
title.en: Refresh setup with Yuzuha’s ready Ultimate before the window

input.zh: 柚叶自己的Q就绪时释放，命中后按薇的实际入场提示。
input.en: Use Yuzuha’s own ready Ultimate, then follow Vivian’s actual entry prompt after the hit.

trigger.zh: 确需刷新准备且柚的喧响已够；不要耗完整个输出窗口重做已有增益。
trigger.en: Setup needs refreshing and Yuzuha has enough Decibels. Do not waste the entire damage window redoing valid buffs.

complete.zh: 发动加2甜度点并给其他队友回能；重击重新挂惊吓后要重新染以太。
complete.en: Activation gives two Sugar Points and energy to other allies. Its heavy hit reapplies Sweet Scare, requiring fresh Ether coloring.

reason.zh: 本招提供辅助准备，不自动让敌人失衡；柚2强制连携仍受真实条件与间隔限制。
reason.en: This is support setup, not automatic enemy Stun. Yuzuha M2 forced Chains still require their real conditions and cooldown.

fallback.zh: Q未就绪可用有能量的EX代替刷新；两者都缺则按已有状态输出或回常态恢复，不假定全队共用喧响。
fallback.en: If Ultimate is unavailable, an affordable EX can refresh setup. If neither is available, use the current state or recover in the regular loop; Decibels are not shared.

signal.zh: 薇的快支或连携提示出现后择一；随后重染以太。
signal.en: Choose one actual Vivian Quick Assist/Chain prompt, then re-establish Ether color.

title.zh: 按提示接薇薇安：两种入场择一
title.en: Enter Vivian once: choose the actual prompt

input.zh: 快支提示：按薇快支，需补羽且已有飞羽时在动作中按住普攻进浮游。连携提示：选择薇连携；本事件只做其中一种。
input.en: Quick Assist: take Vivian’s prompt; when feathers need converting and Flight exists, hold Basic during the move to float. Chain: select Vivian’s Chain instead. Execute only one entry.

trigger.zh: 提示确实指向薇；柚2的合法强制连携或普通失衡连携都以实际提示为准。
trigger.en: The prompt actually targets Vivian. A valid Yuzuha M2 forced Chain or an ordinary Stun Chain must visibly occur.

complete.zh: 薇的以太部分命中完成以太染色；快支默认进淑女，持有飞羽并按住普攻才转浮游；连携回复2飞羽并入浮游。
complete.en: Vivian’s Ether hit establishes Ether color. Quick Assist normally enters Noblewoman; Flight plus held Basic enters Fluttering. Chain gives two Flight and enters Fluttering.

reason.zh: 物理部分不是薇本属性的染色命中；不能把同一次提示算成快支加连携两次入场。
reason.en: The Physical portion is not Vivian’s matching-attribute hit. Do not count one prompt as both Quick Assist and Chain entries.

fallback.zh: 没有提示就跳过，不能空按快支。若已普通切入，使用实际可用招式打以太，再按下一步恢复飞羽。
fallback.en: Skip without a prompt; do not invent an assist. After normal entry, land available Ether damage and restore Flight in the next step.

actionLabel.zh: 快速支援／连携（按实际提示择一）
actionLabel.en: Quick Assist / Chain Attack (choose the actual prompt)

title.zh: 薇Q按自己的喧响与缺羽情况使用
title.en: Use Vivian’s own Ultimate according to readiness and feather need

input.zh: 薇Q就绪、值得补羽时释放；不按住闪避取消浮游。
input.en: Use Vivian’s ready Ultimate when the refill is useful; do not hold Dodge to cancel floating.

trigger.zh: 她自己的Q可用、目标能命中；已有飞羽足够时可省略并接悬落。
trigger.en: Her own Ultimate is available and the target is hittable. Skip to Suspension when existing Flight already suffices.

complete.zh: 获得5飞羽并进入浮游；它们还不是护羽，下一步才转化。
complete.en: Gain five Flight and enter Fluttering. These are not yet Guard; convert them in the following event.

reason.zh: 作者的补羽方法与当前独立喧响并用；不照搬旧资料把大招只留给一人。
reason.en: Combine the authored feather method with current independent Decibels; do not inherit old shared-Ultimate priority.

fallback.zh: Q未就绪，飞羽够则直接悬落；不够时按有能量EX或淑女舞步补，缺资源不等于强行完成本招。
fallback.en: If unavailable, use existing Flight for Suspension; otherwise refill through an affordable EX or Noblewoman Waltz. Missing resources do not count as a completed Ultimate.

title.zh: 确认浮游后悬落，普通切回简
title.en: Confirm Fluttering, then switch normally to Jane

input.zh: 确在裙裾浮游且需转羽时普通切主攻，薇自动悬落；也可先点普攻悬落，动作完成后再切。
input.en: While actually in Fluttering and needing conversion, switch normally to the main attacker to auto-Suspension; alternatively press Basic, finish Suspension, then switch.

trigger.zh: 已经进入浮游，不只是持有飞羽。染色应已是以太；护羽不缺可省略本招但仍完成普通换人。
trigger.en: Fluttering must actually be active; merely owning Flight is insufficient. Ether color should be established. Skip the move if Guard is sufficient, but still switch normally.

complete.zh: 悬落消耗现有飞羽，按实际结果核对护羽（最多5）；薇6还会消耗护羽，不能沿用动作前库存。
complete.en: Suspension spends current Flight; read the resulting Guard, capped at five. Vivian M6 also spends Guard, so do not carry over the pre-move count.

reason.zh: 这是固定技能明确允许的自动悬落交棒；后台落羽仍要真实护羽和触发，不能当无限自动输出。
reason.en: The fixed skill explicitly permits this auto-Suspension handoff. Later off-field Featherbloom still needs real Guard and triggers.

fallback.zh: 未浮游先回补羽步骤；如果以太染色和护羽已经够用，跳过悬落并普通切主攻，不要卡在原角色。
fallback.en: If not floating, return to feather setup. If Ether color and Guard already suffice, skip Suspension and switch normally; do not remain on the wrong character.

signal.zh: 确认浮游才可切出自动悬落；省略补羽时也要普通切回主攻。
signal.en: Only actual Fluttering allows auto-Suspension; skipping a refill still requires a normal switch back to the main attacker.

title.zh: 简Q就绪时兑现并重建狂热
title.en: Cash out Jane’s ready Ultimate and restore Passion

input.zh: 目标可输出时使用简自己的终结技。
input.en: Use Jane’s own Ultimate against a hittable target.

trigger.zh: 简的喧响确已够用，辅助准备有效；考虑狂热余量，避免浪费回复。
trigger.en: Jane has enough Decibels and valid support setup; check Passion space to avoid wasting the refill.

complete.zh: 招式发动就进入狂热并回满心流；确认攻击命中后按实际异常继续。
complete.en: Activation enters Passion and fills Passion Stream; after confirming the hit, continue from the actual Anomaly state.

reason.zh: 回满是发动效果，不要求先命中；是否强击、紊乱与薇落羽则另按实际结果。
reason.en: The refill occurs on activation, not only on hit. Assault, Disorder and Vivian’s triggers still depend on actual results.

fallback.zh: Q未就绪继续常态；下一步萨霍夫仍需实际次数与回复空间，不因列在Q后就强制释放。
fallback.en: If unavailable, continue the regular loop. The following Salchow still needs a real use and gauge space; being listed after Ultimate does not force it.

label.zh: 以太彩糖花火 · 仅限已染以太且甜蜜惊吓仍在的目标
label.en: Ether Sugarburst · only on the Ether-colored target while Sweet Scare remains

label.zh: 落羽生花 · 有护羽且实际命中EX／队友施加异常时触发
label.en: Featherbloom · requires Guard Feathers and an actual EX hit / ally-applied Anomaly

title.zh: 狂热有余量时用萨霍夫跳续航
title.en: Use Salchow Jump with room to restore Passion

input.zh: 有使用次数时长按普攻；按安全时机松开打终结一击。
input.en: With a use available, hold Basic; release safely for the finishing hit.

trigger.zh: 狂热有效且有可用次数，心流已有回复空间；本轮不为回满而无故溢出。
trigger.en: Passion is active, a use remains, and the gauge has room for recovery; avoid wasting the refill.

complete.zh: 实际命中回复心流；完成终结一击后再处理补辅助或继续输出。
complete.en: Actual hits restore Passion Stream. Finish the final hit before refreshing supports or continuing damage.

reason.zh: 这队先给稳定续航，不沿用简赛露的招架方向，也不声称任意时刻普通切人都能保住终结一击。
reason.en: This route favors reliable upkeep; it does not inherit Jane/Seth/Lucy’s parry direction or assume every ordinary early switch preserves the finisher.

fallback.zh: 无次数或未狂热就用普攻及实际闪避恢复；需补辅助时完成可用攻击后仍普通切柚。
fallback.en: Without a use or Passion, recover through Basics and actual dodges. If support needs refreshing, finish the available attack and still switch normally to Yuzuha.

label.zh: 以太彩糖花火 · 仅限已染以太且甜蜜惊吓仍在的目标
label.en: Ether Sugarburst · only on the Ether-colored target while Sweet Scare remains

label.zh: 落羽生花 · 有护羽且实际命中EX／队友施加异常时触发
label.en: Featherbloom · requires Guard Feathers and an actual EX hit / ally-applied Anomaly

prep.zh: 前四项是需要时的窗口前准备；已有覆盖就跳过，别用整个失衡时间补课。
prep.en: The first four events are pre-window setup only when needed; skip them if coverage already holds.

prep.zh: 任何Q未就绪就用现有资源回常态；柚2连携不等于真正失衡，不假定固定大招数量。
prep.en: If an Ultimate is unavailable, continue from current resources. Yuzuha M2 Chains do not imply actual Stun or guarantee a fixed Ultimate count.

text.zh: 柚1开场补30能量，不在每轮重发；仍检查本次EX是否可用。
text.en: Yuzuha M1 gives 30 opening energy, not a refill every loop; check actual EX availability.

text.zh: 柚2的指定重击命中未失衡敌人可强制连携，受20秒间隔限制；接薇事件按真实提示择一，强制连携不代表敌人已失衡。
text.en: Yuzuha M2 can force a Chain on a qualifying heavy hit against a non-Stunned enemy, with a 20-second cooldown. Choose the actual Vivian entry prompt; a forced Chain does not mean the enemy is Stunned.

text.zh: 柚4支援突击命中也能给快支；只有实际招架与突击条件成立才用，不凭空插入支援。
text.en: Yuzuha M4 adds Quick Assist on an Assist Follow-Up hit; use it only after a valid parry/follow-up, not as a free entry.

text.zh: 柚6蓄力夹心硬糖射击要先有合法支援突击与甜度点；强力炮弹实际命中才叠紊乱增益，本基础轴不默认已满层。
text.en: Yuzuha M6 charged Stuffed Hard Candy Shot needs a valid follow-up and Sugar Points. Powerful shell hits build its Disorder buff; this baseline does not assume full stacks.

text.zh: 柚专武掌控增益要求EX／Q造成物理伤害；全队精通要求追加攻击实际命中，不只看装备或发动。
text.en: Yuzuha’s signature AM buff needs Physical damage from EX/Ultimate; team AP needs an actual Aftershock hit, not merely equipment or activation.

text.zh: 薇1每累计消耗4护羽回复1飞羽；飞羽仍需实际进入浮游后转护羽，不能当作直接补护羽。
text.en: Vivian M1 gives one Flight per four Guard spent; Flight still needs actual floating/conversion rather than being counted as Guard immediately.

text.zh: 薇2提高以太积蓄与异放收益，但不取消护羽、命中或异常目标门槛。
text.en: Vivian M2 improves Ether buildup and Abloom, without removing Guard, hit or Anomalous-target requirements.

text.zh: 薇4只在开场给5护羽，可省无必要补羽；以太染色仍要她的本属性命中。
text.en: Vivian M4 starts with five Guard, allowing unnecessary refills to be skipped; Ether coloring still needs her matching-attribute hit.

text.zh: 薇6发动EX或舞步突进中实际极限闪避可额外回1飞羽，仍受上限限制；悬落会额外消耗护羽结算特殊异放，结束后重读库存，主攻EX不能沿用悬落前护羽。
text.en: Vivian M6 grants one extra Flight on EX activation or an actual Perfect Dodge during Waltz, still subject to the cap. Suspension also spends Guard for a special Abloom; recheck afterward rather than carrying pre-Suspension Guard into the main attacker’s EX.

text.zh: 薇专武提高积蓄，精通层数来自实际以太伤害并受触发间隔限制；本轴不预填满层。
text.en: Vivian’s signature improves buildup; AP stacks come from actual Ether damage and obey their trigger interval. This route does not prefill stacks.

text.zh: 简1提高萨霍夫可用次数上限；仍看本次实际次数，不把上限当作每轮赠送。
text.en: Jane M1 raises the Salchow use cap; check actual available uses rather than granting the cap every loop.

text.zh: 作者在简投入显著高于薇时提出染物理替代；本条仍是柚→薇→简的以太路线，不因简2自动改染。染物理需改成薇→柚→简并由简先命中。
text.en: The author suggests Physical coloring when Jane is much more invested than Vivian. This remains the Yuzuha→Vivian→Jane Ether route; M2 alone does not recolor it. Physical needs Vivian→Yuzuha→Jane and Jane’s first qualifying hit.

text.zh: 简6在队伍实际施加强击时直接进入狂热并回满心流；只有真实强击才算，不把任意物理命中当回满。
text.en: Jane M6 enters Passion and refills it when the squad actually applies Assault; any Physical hit is not enough.

text.zh: 简专武以冲刺攻击或极限闪避维持猎意；看实际层数与持续时间，不因有专武而永久算满层。
text.en: Jane’s signature maintains Predatory Instinct through Dash Attacks or Perfect Dodges; check real stacks/duration, not permanent full stacks.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柚叶EX挂惊吓，再接薇薇安: 点强化特殊技，命中后看薇薇安的提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.按提示接薇薇安：两种入场择一: 看提示选薇薇安快支或连携
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.飞羽不够再补，已有资源就省略: 飞羽不够时点强化特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.确认浮游后悬落，普通切回简: 浮游中普通切简，让薇薇安自动悬落
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.简站场建立强击，观察护羽触发: 普攻积强击，看到来招再闪避
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.简EX命中，带动薇的落羽: 点按强化特殊技并命中
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.狂热有余量时用萨霍夫跳续航: 狂热有次数时长按普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.窗口前用就绪的柚Q刷新准备: 柚叶开终结技，命中后看薇薇安的提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.薇Q按自己的喧响与缺羽情况使用: 缺羽且终结技就绪时再开
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.简Q就绪时兑现并重建狂热: 简的终结技就绪时恢复狂热

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.能量足够时点按EX；命中后按薇薇安实际亮起的支援或连携提示。: 能量够时点按强化特殊技。命中后若亮起薇薇安的快速支援就按支援键；出现连携选项则选薇薇安。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.快支提示：按薇快支，需补羽且已有飞羽时在动作中按住普攻进浮游。连携提示：选择薇连: 出现薇薇安的快支提示就按支援键；已有飞羽且需要浮游，可在支援中长按普攻。若出现的是连携窗口，选择薇薇安，不再按一次快支。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.缺飞羽且能量够时点按薇EX；不要按住闪避取消浮游。: 飞羽不够且能量足够时，点按强化特殊技。想保留浮游就不要按住闪避。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.能量足够时点按EX，完成踢击和横扫。: 能量足够时点按强化特殊技，等踢击和横扫命中。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.柚叶自己的Q就绪时释放，命中后按薇的实际入场提示。: 柚叶自己的终结技就绪时按终结技，命中后看薇薇安实际出现的入场提示。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.薇Q就绪、值得补羽时释放；不按住闪避取消浮游。: 薇薇安的终结技就绪、需要补羽时按终结技。不要按住闪避取消浮游。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1261: 需要狂热时点按普攻命中积攒，进入狂热且有次数才长按普攻。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.141100008: 能量够时点按强化特殊技，让炸弹命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.141100015: 终结技就绪时按终结技，等命中

126100001: 本步用普攻命中积狂热；没有指定必须打到第几段。反击只在极限闪避后点普攻。
Land Basics for Passion here, with no fixed hit count. For a Dodge Counter, tap Basic after a Perfect Dodge.
126100004: 有狂热和可用次数才长按普攻；松开可提前收尾，不需点到某一普攻段数。
Hold Basic with Passion and a charge available; release to finish early. No numbered Basic lead-in.
133100003: 手动悬落才点普攻；已浮游时直接普通切主攻可自动悬落，两条路不要重复按。
Tap Basic for a manual descent. Switching to the carry from Suspension triggers the automatic descent instead; do not do both.
133100014: 先接实际入场提示。只有在快支中、已有飞羽且需要进浮游，才额外长按普攻；不是入场前置。
Respond to the actual entry prompt. Hold Basic during Quick Assist only if you have Flight Feathers and want Suspension; not required before entry.

1261: 缺狂热时可用普攻回资源；只有进入狂热并且有次数才长按。本步没有固定连段。
Use Basic to recover Passion if needed. Hold only in Passion with a charge; no fixed string.
